title: Injective terms of the horizontal good cut
statement: Let I be a bicomplex with horizontal integer degrees and vertical nonnegative degrees in an abelian category. Suppose its negative columns vanish, all its terms are injective, and every term of every horizontal cycle complex is injective. For q>=0, its horizontal good truncation at q has vanishing negative columns and injective terms in every bidegree.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology
source.place: Tag 015X, good horizontal truncation of the CE resolution

proof.text: Below q use the canonical truncation coordinate isomorphism to the original column. At q use the coordinate isomorphism to the horizontal cycles. Above q the column is zero. Transport injectivity through these isomorphisms. A negative horizontal degree lies strictly below q, giving the asserted vanishing.

lean.statement:
theorem cartanEilenberg_horizontal_cut_terms
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (hzero : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (I.X p))
    (hterms : ∀ (p : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective ((I.X p).X r))
    (hcycles : ∀ (p : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective ((I.cycles p).X r))
    (q : ℤ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    (∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero ((CochainComplex.truncLE I q).X p)) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective (((CochainComplex.truncLE I q).X p).X r))
